  exists (updatedStates σ ks' vs')
  have Hk : (isDefined σ' ks) := UpdateStatesDefined Hup
  have Hlen1 := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hlen2 := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  induction Hup generalizing σ''
  case update_none =>
    simp_all
    apply And.intro
    refine updatedStatesInit Hlen1 ?_ ?_
    exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
    exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    simp [InitStatesUpdated Hinit]
    constructor
  case update_some σ x v σ₀ xs vs σ₁ Hup Hups ih =>
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    . apply updatedStatesInit Hlen1
      apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
      apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
      exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
      exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    . apply UpdateStates.update_some (σ':=updatedStates σ₀ ks' vs')
      . simp [UpdateStateUpdated Hup, updatedStates]
        rw [← updatedStateComm']
        . have Hdef := UpdateStateDefined' Hup
          simp [isDefined, Option.isSome] at Hdef
          split at Hdef <;> simp_all
          next val heq =>
          apply updatedStateUpdate (v':=val)
          apply InitStatesSomeMonotone heq
          apply updatedStatesInit
          . simp_all
          . apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
            apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
            apply InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          . exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
        . rw [List.unzip_zip] <;> simp_all
          have Hnd := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          simp [isNotDefined, isDefined] at *
          apply Not.intro
          intros Hin
          specialize Hnd _ Hin
          simp_all
      . apply (ih Hinit ?_ ?_).2.2
        . simp [isDefined] at * <;> simp_all
        . simp_all

  have combine {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a.Subset (b ++ [h1])) (hc : c.Subset (d ++ [h1])) :

    simp only [List.Subset, List.mem_append] at *
    grind only
  induction post <;>
    dsimp only [substOld]
  case const | op | bvar | fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih1 ih2 | eq ih1 ih2 => exact combine ih1 ih2
  case ite cih tih eih => exact combine (combine cih tih) eih
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
      · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
    · exact combine ih1 ih2

  have combine {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a.Subset b) (hc : c.Subset d) : (a ++ c).Subset (b ++ d) :=
    List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ ha,
      List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ hc⟩
  intro h
  induction h <;>
    dsimp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case const | op | bvar | fvar => exact List.nil_subset _
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih1 ih2 | eq ih1 ih2 => exact combine ih1 ih2
  case ite cih tih eih => exact combine (combine cih tih) eih
  case app Hfn He Hn ih1 ih2 =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact List.Subset.refl _
    · next Hfalse =>
      have hf := Hn IsOldPred.oldPred
      cases hf
      exfalso
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    · exact combine ih1 ih2

    · rw [List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength ht)]
      intro hx

      simp [InitStatesNotDefined ht x hx] at hd

    rcases hx with hx | hx

      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
  all_goals try exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case ite ih1 ih2 ih3 => exact join (join ih1 ih2) ih3
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split <;> simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
    · exact join ih1 ih2

by
  have join {a b c d p : Prop} (ha : a → c ∨ p) (hb : b → d ∨ p) :
      a ∨ b → (c ∨ d) ∨ p := fun h =>
    h.elim (fun h => (ha h).imp Or.inl id) (fun h => (hb h).imp Or.inr id)
  intro x
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton,
      List.not_mem_nil, false_or] at *
  all_goals try exact False.elim
  all_goals try exact Or.inl
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case ite ih1 ih2 ih3 => exact join (join ih1 ih2) ih3
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split <;> simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append,
        List.mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil, false_or]
      · exact Or.inr
      · exact Or.inl
    · simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append]
      exact join ih1 ih2

by
  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a.Subset (c ++ [h1])) (hb : b.Subset (d ++ [h1])) :
      (a ++ b).Subset ((c ++ d) ++ [h1]) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (ha hx) with hx | hx
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ hx)
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (hb hx) with hx | hx
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hx)
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ hx
  induction post with
  | const => exact List.Subset.empty
  | op => exact List.Subset.empty
  | bvar => exact List.Subset.empty
  | fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  | abs _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  | ite _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 ih3 => exact join (join ih1 ih2) ih3
  | eq _ _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  | app _ _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [substOld]
    split
    · split
      · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
      · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
    · exact join ih1 ih2

  intro _ x

      List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil] at *
  case app ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars

    · exact Or.inr

    · simp only [List.mem_append]
      exact Or.imp ihfn ihe
  all_goals grind only

  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a.Subset (c ++ [h1])) (hb : b.Subset (d ++ [h1])) :
      (a ++ b).Subset ((c ++ d) ++ [h1]) := by
    simp only [List.Subset, List.mem_append] at *
    grind only []
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  induction post <;> simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case op | const | bvar => exact List.nil_subset _
  case abs => assumption
  case quant | eq => apply join <;> assumption
  case ite =>
    apply join
    · apply join <;> assumption
    · assumption
  case app =>
    split
    · split <;> simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
    · apply join <;> assumption
